description: Defines a set of TypeConverter functions for converting between custom data types (EventType, LeaveType, Date) and database-compatible representations in a Room database setup.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: Contains methods to convert between complex data types and primitive types for database storage.

methods.name: fromTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a Long timestamp to a Date object.

methods.name: dateToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a Date object to its Long timestamp representation.

methods.name: fromEventType
methods.description: Converts an EventType enum to its String name.

methods.name: toEventType
methods.description: Converts a String representation back to an EventType enum.

methods.name: fromLeaveType
methods.description: Converts a LeaveType enum to its String name.

methods.name: toLeaveType
methods.description: Converts a String representation back to a LeaveType enum.
